item.title: 【DVD】DVD9 - t.A.T.u. - The Best (Japan DVD)
item.description:
Hello, Tony here. I’m sharing with you this t.A.T.u. compilation DVD. I actually had this DVD when I was a kid, but I lost it, so it was really hard for me to find—it took searching all over the internet until I finally came across it again. What I love most about this DVD is its aesthetic, especially the menu. I was obsessed with it when I was younger. That’s something I truly love—the amount of detail and care they used to put into DVD menus.
So I’m sharing it with y’all. XOXO
